bulk.title: Bulk pricing, up to 20% off.
bulk.intro: The discount counts every item in your order, mixed garments and sizes included, and comes off automatically.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: One shirt or two hundred, it's the same three steps.
how.step1_text: Tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, sportswear, tote bags and workwear, in the colours and sizes you need.
how.step2_text: Upload a logo or design and tell us where it goes. We check it will print well.
how.step3_text: We send a proof showing your design on the garment at its real print size. Nothing is printed until you approve it. Most orders are ready in 5-7 working days after you approve. Some in-stock tees can be quicker, just ask.

artwork.title: Artwork requirements
artwork.file_types: Vector files are best: SVG, PDF, AI or EPS. PNG also works.
artwork.resolution: At least 300 dpi at the size you want printed.
artwork.background: Transparent, unless you want the background printed too.
artwork.text: In vector files, convert text to outlines so the font prints correctly.
artwork.note: Not sure your file is right? Send what you have and we will check it before anything is printed.

reviews.title: Google reviews
reviews.review1: "Ordered a t-shirt for my daughter's World Book Day. Really good quality, printed in less than 48 hours and much cheaper than online shops."
reviews.review2: "Needed a last minute bespoke T-shirt for a very fussy young customer and the guys went above and beyond to help."
reviews.review3: "I take in second hand t-shirts for him to print my company logo on. Even helps out loads with graphic design and sends the designs across."
